thread:
sasha: CI on main is red, windows-gpu/inference-job failing since ~1750004000. can someone bisect? :grimacing:
liam: saw the alert, failing in gpu-malloc.test::alloc_large on CUDA kernel launch. stacktrace points to lazy-kernel-loader change in #7892
jen: ack, i'll try a quick bisect unless someone else is already on it
ci-bot: [build #11234] windows-gpu/inference-job failed - exit code 137 - logs: https://ci.internal/runs/11234/logs
sasha: thx. last green for that job was at 1750000888 per CI metadata (commit 2c9f1b4). if bisect lands on that PR we should revert asap
liam: running git bisect locally now. starting at 2c9f1b4 (good) -> HEAD (bad)
rahul: pinging @ops-bot to hold any rolling infra updates to windows pools while we triage
ops-bot: noted — pausing scheduled maintenance window for windows-gpu until 1750005600
liam: quick update: bisect narrowed to span containing PR #7892 (author: jen) and #7921 (author: marco). testing commit 9a3d7c2 next
jen: that's my PR (7892) - it touched kernel loader init ordering. i added a delayed mmap to avoid early allocation races. rough idea: could cause 137 if memory mapping differs on windows
sasha: if bisect confirms jen's PR, prefer a temporary revert (revert commit) to get CI green and then follow-up with a fix. we have a scheduled deploy in ~2h — want CI clean before that
liam: bisect result: first bad commit is 9a3d7c2 (part of PR 7892). reproducer: `python tests/run_integration.py --target=windows-gpu --test=alloc_large --repeat=20` fails consistently on that commit
jen: ugh, sorry about that. i can prepare a revert PR now. quick question: is it acceptable to revert the entire PR or just the init ordering patch?
sasha: revert the PR for now (whole PR) to be safe. include a note referencing bisect and the failing job. we'll re-land a smaller fix after proof
jen: creating revert: `git revert -m 1 9a3d7c2 && git push origin revert/7892` -> PR draft in progress
liam: after revert in CI we should run a full matrix for windows-gpu to be sure. I'll kick off reruns for recent red jobs once the revert is merged
rahul: heads up to oncall: if revert causes unexpected regressions, tag me and i'll coordinate hotfixes. also gathering heap traces from failed runs now
ci-bot: [rerun requested] build #11235 queued by liam
sasha: thanks team. timeline: revert PR, wait for CI green on windows-gpu matrix, then unblock deploy. Jen — if you want help narrowing the init-order change I'd be happy to pair
jen: appreciated, i'll open a follow-up branch with smaller diffs and request a pairing session after the revert lands. sorry again :disappointed:
liam: one more thing — adding a quick test to stress mmap boundaries on windows would help catch this early. filing issue to track: https://issues.internal/INF-2345
sasha: perfect. mark this thread resolved once revert is merged and all windows-gpu jobs are green :thumbsup:
jen: revert PR merged at 1750004455, CI reruns in progress
ci-bot: [build #11235] success
ci-bot: [build #11236] success
liam: all green on the recent matrix, closing the loop. thanks everyone
rahul: noted root cause and follow-up plan in INF-2345, assigning to jen for the fix and liam for the test case
sasha: great work. moving deploy back to scheduled window. :rocket:
